{"id":1913389955,"question_id":4211,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1770634951,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"115 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1913389955/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Subarrays With Cost Less Than or Equal to K","memory":"191.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    long long countSubarrays(vector<int>& nums, long long k) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        int l = 0;\n        deque<ll>maxi;\n        deque<ll>mini;\n\n        ll count = 0;\n        for(int r = 0 ; r<n ; r++)\n        {\n            int curr = nums[r];\n            while(!maxi.empty() and nums[maxi.back()] <= curr)\n            {\n                maxi.pop_back();\n            }\n            maxi.push_back(r);\n\n            while(!mini.empty() and nums[mini.back()] >= curr)\n            {\n                mini.pop_back();\n            }\n            mini.push_back(r);\n\n            while((((ll)nums[maxi.front()] - (ll)nums[mini.front()]) * (r-l+1)) > k)\n            {\n                if(mini.front() == l) mini.pop_front();\n                if(maxi.front() == l) maxi.pop_front();\n                l++;\n            }\n            count += (r-l+1);\n        }\n        return count;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-subarrays-with-cost-less-than-or-equal-to-k","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1678}
